needed.evidence: No continuous paved sidewalk; only a grassy verge and a trodden strip between the road edge and the buildings.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous paved footway at least 1.5 m wide along the left side, separated from the carriageway by a raised kerb.

needed.evidence: No formal sidewalk; pedestrians are walking on an uneven dirt and gravel shoulder beside the road.
needed.suggestion: Build a paved footway on the right side with a dropped kerb at the junction to give pedestrians a safe, level route off the carriageway.

needed.evidence: The informal path on the right is uneven, with loose gravel, potholes and a mound of earth.
needed.suggestion: Resurface and level the right-side path, removing the earth mound and filling potholes to create a smooth, even walking surface.

needed.evidence: There is a junction and activity on both sides creating crossing demand, but no marked or purpose-built crossing is visible.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with high-visibility markings and signage at the junction to give pedestrians a defined, safer place to cross.
